original_test_intent: Verify that a persistent UCE inside a 10% ARM mirrored region is handled and logged, then causes the mapped MC0 channel0 failover indication while the firmware-first extlog path remains observable.
original_method: Record baseline and literal ARM/TAD/patrol/RAS/debug settings; halt, verify mirror/ECC/P/P or ParMirr and map TAD/sa2da; reset injector lock, set both masks0x3 and inject persistent UCE at0x100000300; inspect b2cmi1 status/misc for correction and mirror scrub; clear injectors, go once, inspect b2cmi1 mirrorfailover for ddr4chnlfailed bit0 mapped to MC0 ch0; capture FTrace extlog_mem_event; recover failed channel and restore settings.
manual_activity: Intel-qualified owner/FAE validates the partial-mirror range and failover oracle, controls the persistent injection/clear/go sequence and channel recovery while the agent correlates controller and FTrace evidence.
required_inputs: CScripts version/hash/license and translated ARM/TAD/patrol paths
TAD/sa2da proof for0x100000300 and b2cmi1/MC0-ch0 mapping
Persistent masks, corrected/scrub and ddr4chnlfailed bit0 oracle
FTrace timing, serial/OOB and failed-channel recovery/restoration plan
safety_requirements: Dedicated workload-free SUT with live serial/OOB
Reject non-mirrored target, wrong initial state or unexplained existing failover
Inject persistent UCE once only, then clear injectors exactly as approved
Stop on wrong channel/bit, unexpected reset, missing extlog or failed recovery
Preserve degraded-state evidence and restore channel/knobs under owner control
agent_execution_scope: Validate approved ARM mapping and failover oracle
Collect one persistent injection, B2CMI/failover and FTrace evidence
Correlate bit0 with the mapped target
Do not select address, inject/retry/recover independently or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve ARM range and persistent recipe
Approve B2CMI/failover decoding and injector clearing

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The persistent partial-mirror procedure coherently expects an initially corrected mirrored event followed by mapped channel-failure logging after clearing injectors and go.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row169 Wistron-System RAS-00126-V002: approve GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM topology, CScripts version/hash/license and ARM Mirror10%/TAD0/patrol/RAS/debug mappings; prove0x100000300 is mirrored and maps to b2cmi1/MC0-ch0, define corrected/scrub fields, clearMemInjectors timing, ddr4chnlfailed bit0 and extlog_mem_event oracle, and provide degraded-channel OOB no-retry recovery/restoration.

review_improvement: Separates this persistent failover case from the transient neighbor, requires explicit address/bit attribution and preserves the source injector-clear plus firmware-first logging coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Persistent corruption can be corrected from the mirror on first access yet make scrub back to the damaged channel fail, so the later channel-failure bit is the distinguishing result. Clearing the injector before go bounds further fault creation but does not erase the already written corruption. TAD/sa2da establishes that bit0 truly identifies the target MC0 channel0, while extlog establishes the error-reporting path. Repeating would confound both transition and recovery.
